Subject: Request: Evidence & TIA logistics for cross-border transfers

Marcus / FinServe team —

Thanks for the call earlier. Per your InfoSec and legal asks, can you confirm the exact evidence pack you need for your procurement / legal review so we can scope the TIA (Transfer Impact Assessment) and any UK IDTA items? To be concrete, please confirm whether you require:

- Signed SCCs + UK Addendum (we can provide standard Redwood redlines)
- A completed TIA/DTIA template (we typically provide a TIA + mitigation appendix)
- Full active subprocessor list + expected onboarding timeline
- SOC 2 Type II report (we can share current report under NDA)
- Encryption at-rest/in-transit details and KMS model (customer-managed vs. Redwood-managed)
- Data residency & deletion confirmation for exported logs/backups

Our internal plan: Mina (privacy) will own the TIA and DPA redlines; Karthik (legal ops) will manage DocuSign and any contract-side escalations. If you can indicate which items are mandatory vs. optional and any internal deadlines, we will prioritize.

Attachments: redwood_sccs_summary.pdf (summary table of our standard SCC/UK Addendum approach)

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the mandatory evidence list and any format constraints (DocuSign, PDF with wet signature not needed).
2) We provide a redlined DPA + TIA draft within 3 business days.
3) Quick 30-minute session (if helpful) to review mitigations.

Availability: today 17:00-18:00 CEST or tomorrow morning CEST.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Sean —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. For procurement and security gate we need the following as MUST-HAVES before we progress to Legal: 

1) Signed SCCs + UK IDTA addendum: we will want to see your standard SCCs and the proposed UK addendum language. Please flag any non-standard clauses we should escalate.
2) Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA / DTIA): full template with your technical mitigations for transfers to non-EEA jurisdictions. Include threat model and residual risk rating.
3) Active subprocessor register (current) + planned onboarding list for next 6 months. For each subprocessor include location, access scope, and whether they hold keys.
4) SOC 2 Type II report (latest) and statement of encryption in transit/at rest, including whether customer-managed keys are supported (we prefer CMK).
5) Data deletion/retention workflow for exported logs and backup snapshots (we require deletion confirmations within 30 days of contract termination).
6) A short rollback/stop-gap plan that describes how Redwood would remove a subprocessor from processing FinServe data and a timeline for full data deletion from that subprocessor.

Delivery format: PDFs for legal artifacts, spreadsheet (.xlsx) for the subprocessor register. If you can upload to the secure S3 link we'll send a short-lived presigned URL.

We can do a 30-minute call tomorrow at 10:30 CET — will that work? Also, for the SCCs: we will circulate any redlines back to you; please confirm if Redwood accepts limited redlines on Processor obligations or if you require a full DPA amendment path.

Attaching: FinServe-TIA-Requirements.pdf (our checklist)

— Marcus

> Sean —
> 
> Appreciate the quick follow-up. For procurement and security gate we need the following as MUST-HAVES before we progress to Legal: 
> 
> 1) Signed SCCs + UK IDTA addendum: we will want to see your standard SCCs and the proposed UK addendum language. Please flag any non-standard clauses we should escalate.
> 2) Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA / DTIA): full template with your technical mitigations for transfers to non-EEA jurisdictions. Include threat model and residual risk rating.
> 3) Active subprocessor register (current) + planned onboarding list for next 6 months. For each subprocessor include location, access scope, and whether they hold keys.
> 4) SOC 2 Type II report (latest) and statement of encryption in transit/at rest, including whether customer-managed keys are supported (we prefer CMK).
> 5) Data deletion/retention workflow for exported logs and backup snapshots (we require deletion confirmations within 30 days of contract termination).
> 6) A short rollback/stop-gap plan that describes how Redwood would remove a subprocessor from processing FinServe data and a timeline for full data deletion from that subprocessor.

Marcus — thanks for the clarity. Quick answers and what we'll deliver: 

- SCCs + UK Addendum: we will attach the standard Redwood SCC pack and a proposed UK Addendum. Redwood typically accepts limited redlines on Processor obligations but escalates indemnity/limit of liability items. We'll mark any clauses that require legal review in the redline.

- TIA/DTIA: we will provide a completed TIA template scoped to your control plane and inference traffic, including threat model, residual risk scoring, and mitigations (KV cache controls, continuous batching boundaries, prefix caching mitigations).

- Subprocessor register: we will provide a spreadsheet with current subprocessors, location, access scope, and key custody flags. For planned onboarding we will mark projected quarter and risk tier.

- SOC 2 + encryption: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II under NDA. Regarding keys: we support both Redwood-managed encryption and customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). We'll confirm which subsystems use CMK vs. Redwood keys.

- Deletion/retention: our standard data deletion workflow will be documented; for backups we can provide a 30-day deletion SLA for export snapshots tied to the contract. Where required, we can agree to escalation triggers for verified deletion.

- Subprocessor rollback plan: we will produce a short plan that includes immediate blocking (policy), data access revocation, and a best-effort data purge timeline from the subprocessor with verification steps. Note that deletion timelines may vary by subprocessor (we will flag any with longer retention due to contractual reasons).

Action items (we own):
1) Draft redlined DPA + SCCs (proposed-dpia-redlined.docx).
2) Completed TIA (TIA-FinServe-FS-2026-09-003.pdf).
3) Subprocessor register (.xlsx).
4) SOC 2 upload under NDA.

We can have the package to you by end of day Friday (2026-09-25). Confirm whether the presigned S3 link is preferred or a secure Drive folder — we can support both.

Proposed call: tomorrow 10:30 CET works for us. If you want guards on the call (only legal + security), say the word and we'll keep it lean.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
